title: International Postgraduate Diploma in Executive Management (Level 7)
description: The IPGD in Executive Management is a specialized program designed to equip professionals with the skills and knowledge required to manage business organizations effectively.
longDescription: The International Postgraduate Diploma (IPGD) in executive management is designed to fit around work and personal commitments. To enrich the learning experience, world-class teaching is delivered via pre-recorded online lectures. Our practice-based approach focuses on addressing real-world business problems. The Programme offers an efficient approach beyond traditional classroom learning. The course emphasises real-world applications through case studies, business simulations, and 100% project-based learning, allowing participants to practice what they learn in a controlled environment before applying it to their roles. The International Postgraduate Diploma (IPGD) in Executive Management allows you to achieve the qualification in 9 months. It is a fast track to new opportunities and enhanced career prospects. The curriculum combines theory and practice to equip learners with the skills to address complex operational challenges and deliver strategic solutions in executive management level.
courseDetails: The International Postgraduate Diploma (IPGD) in Executive Management aims to provide business professionals with a comprehensive skill set for leadership and management roles within the business sector. This qualification reflects current practices in Executive Management and allows learners to develop and expand their high-level understanding of Management business issues. Course Details: Business Strategic Management: This module explores the regulatory frameworks and policies that govern business opertaions. Corporate Financial Management: This course focuses on best practices for managing finanical institutions effectively. Project Management: This module examines project management all details and establish in strengthening stakeholders relations. Strategic Management: This course explores strategic planning in organisations, covering long-term vision, risk management, and adapting to changing industry trends. Human Resource Management: This module focuses on effectively managing human resources in business organizations. Operations Management: This module covers managing executive operations, emphasising streamlining processes, improving service delivery, and ensuring effciect management support. Logistic & Supply Chain Management: This module focus in enhancing intermediaries networking & ensure smooth delivery of product and services to customers. Assessment: Graduation Project (GP) Upon finishing the coursework, students must complete a graduation project(GP) that combines and utilises the knowledge acquired across different modules. This qualification embodies current practices in executive mangement and helps learners deepen and broaden their understanding of the field at an advanced level. Programme Structure and Credits: This programme comprises 6 modules with 30 ECTS and 1 GP of 30 ECTS.

entry: An honours degree in a related subject or the UK level 6 diploma or equivalent overseas qualification, i.e. Bachelors Degree or Higher National Diploma.
Mature learners (over 25) with at least five years of management experience if they do not possess the above qualification (this is reviewed on a case-by-case basis).

accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
progression: University Top-up On completion of this course, students have the opportunity to complete a Master degree programme from Partner University. The top-up programme can be studied online or on campus. The top-up comprises the final 60 credits which consist of either a dissertation or a dissertation and one module. workshops: This is a self-study programme with unlimited tutor support. You will never be more than a message or phone call away from our tutors. Workshops are conducted by live webinars for online students. Classroom workshops are available if there is a local branch in your country. Speak to our course advisors on this subject.
visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.

modules.summary: This module provides a comprehensive understanding of the financial management practices and decisions that drive corporate performance. It focuses on key financial principles, tools, and strategies that organizations use to manage their financial resources effectively. Students will learn how to analyze financial information, make informed investment and financing decisions, and evaluate the impact of financial strategies on corporate value.

modules.title: HUMAN RESOURCE MANAGEMENT
modules.summary: This module explores the fundamental principles, strategies, and practices of Human Resource Management (HRM) and how they contribute to organizational success. Students will gain an understanding of the role of HR in recruiting, developing, and retaining talent, as well as managing employee performance and promoting a positive organizational culture. The module emphasizes the strategic role of HRM in aligning people management with business objectives and adapting to an ever-changing workforce environment.

modules.title: MANAGING OPERATIONS
modules.summary: The Managing Operations module focuses on the key principles, processes, and strategies involved in the effective management of operations within an organization. It covers both manufacturing and service operations, emphasizing the importance of designing, controlling, and improving operational processes to ensure efficiency, quality, and customer satisfaction. The module equips students with the tools to manage resources, optimize performance, and contribute to the organization’s overall strategic goals.

modules.title: BUSINESS RESEARCH METHODOLOGY
modules.summary: The Business Research Methods (BRM) module equips students with the knowledge and skills necessary to conduct rigorous and effective research in a business context. It covers both qualitative and quantitative research methodologies, providing a comprehensive framework for designing, executing, and analyzing research projects. The module emphasizes the importance of research in decision-making, problem-solving, and business strategy formulation. Students will learn how to collect, analyze, and interpret data to make informed business decisions and contribute to academic or industry-specific knowledge.

modules.title: LOGISTIC AND SUPPLY CHAIN MANAGEMENT
modules.summary: The Logistics and Supply Chain Management module provides students with a comprehensive understanding of the processes and strategies involved in managing the flow of goods, services, and information across the supply chain. This module covers key concepts such as procurement, transportation, warehousing, inventory management, and the integration of supply chain activities to enhance organizational efficiency and customer satisfaction. Students will explore how effective supply chain management can create competitive advantages and improve overall business performance.

modules.title: STRATEGIC MANAGEMENT
modules.summary: The Strategic Management module focuses on the concepts, tools, and frameworks necessary for crafting, implementing, and evaluating business strategies. Students will explore how organizations establish strategic goals, analyze competitive environments, and make decisions that shape the future direction of the company. The module covers topics such as competitive advantage, strategic positioning, corporate governance, and innovation management. By applying strategic analysis to real-world business cases, students will develop the ability to think critically and strategically about complex business challenges.

modules.title: PROJECT MANAGEMENT
modules.summary: The Project Management module provides students with essential knowledge, tools, and techniques required to successfully plan, execute, and deliver projects. The module covers the entire project lifecycle, from project initiation and planning to monitoring, controlling, and closing projects. It explores key concepts such as project scope, time, cost, quality management, risk assessment, and stakeholder communication. Students will gain practical skills in project management methodologies and software tools to enhance their ability to manage projects efficiently across various industries.
